items.title: Portugal. The Man with the Oregon Symphony (Nov 11 and 12)
items.action: Last chance: buy face value from the Oregon Symphony for Thursday's show at the Arlene Schnitzer Concert Hall, not resale.
items.why: Two concerts with the band backed by its hometown orchestra, per the Oregon Symphony.

items.title: Fall Out Boy, Providence Park (Aug 26, 2027)
items.action: Artist presale opened Wed, Nov 11 at 10 a.m. (sign up at twilightofthepunkstour.com); general on-sale is Thu, Nov 12 at 10 a.m. PT.
items.why: Newly announced stadium stop on the Twilight of the Punks tour with The Offspring, Good Charlotte and The Story So Far; the Timbers say general sale opens Nov 12 at 10 a.m. PT.

items.title: WWE Friday Night SmackDown, Moda Center (Jan 29, 2027)
items.action: Tickets go on sale Wed, Nov 11 at 10 a.m. local through Ticketmaster.
items.why: One of 11 new early-2027 WWE dates announced by WWE.

items.title: Ricky Montgomery, Crystal Ballroom (May 3, 2027)
items.action: General sale Fri, Nov 13 at 10 a.m.; buy face value through Etix/Cascade Tickets, the ballroom's official seller.
items.why: Listings call it his first Portland show since 2024; date comes from ticket listings, not an official artist page.

items.title: Epic Pass price increase
items.action: Buy before Nov 15 to beat the next price step; sales end Dec 6.
items.why: Powder lists the Epic Pass at $1,169 as of Oct 13, with the next increase Nov 15.

items.title: Oregon vs. Oregon State basketball, Moda Center (Nov 19)
items.action: On sale now through Ticketmaster and the Moda Center box office.
items.why: First Civil War meeting in Portland since 1996; public sale opened Oct 22.

items.title: ZooLights at the Oregon Zoo (Nov 20 to Jan 3)
items.action: Buy dated tickets ahead; prices range $13 to $35 by night, and Any Night tickets work Nov 20 to Dec 31.
items.why: Tickets are sold in advance online and price varies by date, so earlier and weeknight picks are cheaper.

items.title: Christmas Mountain U-cut trees, Scappoose (opens Nov 21)
items.action: Plan a U-cut trip from Nov 21; noble, Nordmann, Douglas and grand fir.
items.why: The farm posted that it opens for the 2026 season on Saturday, Nov 21.

items.title: Blazers vs. Warriors on Black Friday, Moda Center (Nov 27)
items.action: Get seats early for the 6:30 p.m. tip-off.
items.why: KATU picks the Black Friday Warriors visit as one of the marquee home games on the 2026-27 schedule.

items.title: Kann: January reservations
items.action: Book on Resy Dec 1 at noon, when the next month's tables are released.
items.why: Kann's FAQ says it releases one month of reservations on the 1st of the prior month at noon; confirm the schedule is still current.

items.title: Christmas Ships viewing dinner
items.action: Check the 2026 route schedule, then reserve a riverside window table for a night the fleet passes.
items.why: The official site says the 2026 schedule is posted, and a festival listing puts the parades Dec 3 to 20; Vancouver's tourism office advises reserving waterfront seats well in advance (Vancouver nights listed Dec 16 to 18).

items.title: Oregon Ballet Theatre: Balanchine's The Nutcracker (Dec 5 to 24)
items.action: Single tickets are on sale from OBT; buy direct for face value rather than resale.
items.why: Runs at Keller Auditorium Dec 5 to 24, with a noon show on Christmas Eve.

items.title: Ikon Pass final sales window
items.action: Buy by Dec 10 at the current $1,529 adult price.
items.why: Ikon shows the current price valid until Dec 10; last year sales stopped Dec 11.

items.title: Mt. Hood National Forest Christmas tree permit
items.action: Watch Recreation.gov for this year's $5 permits and print yours; digital copies aren't accepted.
items.why: The Forest Service says the season is closed and reopens in November 2026; last year it opened Nov 14. Permits are $5 plus a $2.50 Recreation.gov fee, five per household.

items.title: Coast state park campsites
items.action: Book Fort Stevens or Nehalem Bay exactly six months before your arrival date on the state's reservation site.
items.why: Oregon State Parks takes reservations up to six months ahead; Cape Lookout's campground has been closed for improvements since Aug 3, 2026.

items.title: Barnes & Noble Criterion 50% off sale (through Dec 6)
items.action: Buy Criterion 4K wish-list titles now, online or in store; the sale ends Dec 6.
items.why: Criterion says all in-stock discs are half off at B&N through Dec 6; B&N notes it doesn't combine with the Premium Member discount.

items.title: Sylvan Esso, Crystal Ballroom (Feb 22 and 23, 2027)
items.action: Tickets are on sale now; buy face value through the venue's ticketing for either night before the ballroom shows sell through.
items.why: Two Portland nights on the band's 2026-27 tour; the Portland on-sale date wasn't confirmed in the sources found.

items.title: CHVRCHES, Revolution Hall (Mar 8, 2027)
items.action: Artist presale began Oct 27; check Revolution Hall for remaining tickets before the small room sells through.
items.why: New album All the King's Men and a 2027 North American tour; the North American general on-sale date wasn't confirmed in the sources found.

items.title: Queens of the Stone Age with Pixies, Moda Center (May 9, 2027)
items.action: General sale opened Thu Oct 29 at 10 a.m.; buy face value through Live Nation rather than resale.
items.why: Perfecth World Tour with Pixies and Portland's Wheelchair Sports Camp opening; artist presales ran Oct 27 and 28.

items.title: Oregon Sno-Park permit (required Nov 1 to Apr 30)
items.action: Buy an annual permit online from Oregon DMV or a local vendor before your first Mt. Hood snow trip; they aren't sold at the Sno-Parks.
items.why: The Forest Service says permits are required at designated Sno-Parks Nov 1 through Apr 30, and Oregon DMV sells annual permits online Oct 1 through Apr 15 with a printable two-week interim permit.

items.title: Gracie Abrams, Moda Center (Jan 31 and Feb 1, 2027)
items.action: Tickets are on sale; buy face value through Ticketmaster or the Moda Center rather than resale.
items.why: Two Portland nights on The Look at My Life Tour, per KOIN.

items.title: DIIV, Revolution Hall (May 12, 2027)
items.action: General sale opened Fri Oct 30 at 10 a.m.; buy face value through Revolution Hall's ticketing before the room sells through.
items.why: Newly announced stop on the ZIRP! world tour, with new single "Dare Me"; no Portland presale details were found in the sources.

items.title: Nothing But Thieves, Crystal Ballroom (Apr 1, 2027)
items.action: Check Live Nation for the Crystal Ballroom date and buy face value there rather than resale.
items.why: Spring 2027 North American tour behind the new album Stray Dogs; the Portland on-sale and presale dates weren't confirmed in the sources found.

items.title: Royal Blood with Bodega, Revolution Hall (Apr 18, 2027)
items.action: Presale Thu, Nov 12 at 10 a.m. via Ticketmaster; general on-sale Fri, Nov 13 at 10 a.m.
items.why: Newly announced 2027 North American tour stop at Revolution Hall with Bodega opening.

items.title: King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard, Portland (Aug 19, 2027)
items.action: Mailing-list presale started Nov 11; general on-sale Fri, Nov 13 at 9 a.m. Pacific. Venue not yet announced.
items.why: New album Entropy and two 2027 North American legs; the Portland venue is listed as TBD.
